demo-cafe.title: 咖啡馆里的礼貌点单（虚构演示）
demo-cafe.summary: 虚构课程：用 I’d like 和 Could you 礼貌点单，并练习 a cup of 的数量表达。
demo-cafe.author: LinguaTree 虚构课程
demo-cafe.asr_text:
[Fictional teaching dialogue]
Guest: I’d like a cup of tea and a sandwich, please.
Server: Of course. Would you like milk with your tea?
Guest: Yes, please. Could you bring two cups of water as well?
Server: Certainly.
Practice mistake: Could you brings the menu?
Correction: Could you bring the menu?
demo-cafe.vlm_description: 虚构文字课程，没有关联的视频文件。
demo-cafe.manual_transcript:
[Fictional teaching dialogue]
Guest: I’d like a cup of tea and a sandwich, please.
Server: Of course. Would you like milk with your tea?
Guest: Yes, please. Could you bring two cups of water as well?
Server: Certainly.
Practice mistake: Could you brings the menu?
Correction: Could you bring the menu?

ores.description: 用 Could you + 动词原形提出礼貌请求，适用于问路、点餐和寻求帮助。

ores.ore_name: I would like… 点餐表达
ores.description: 用 I would like / I’d like 表达想要，比 I want 更适合礼貌点餐。
可数名词可以搭配 a/an 和复数；tea 等不可数名词常借助 a cup of 等量词表达数量。

choice.question: 哪一句是在咖啡馆礼貌请求菜单的表达？
choice.explanation: could 后直接接动词原形 bring，please 使语气更友好。
options: Could you bring the menu, please?
Could you to bring the menu?

fill.question: 补全句子：I’d like two ___ of tea, please.
fill.explanation: two 后接复数 cups；two cups of tea 表示两杯茶。

judge.question: “I’d like a sandwich, please.” 可以用来礼貌点餐。
judge.explanation: I’d like 是 I would like 的缩写，适合礼貌表达想要的食物。

demo-city.title: 从图书馆到车站（虚构演示）
demo-city.summary: 虚构课程：学习问路、按顺序描述路线，以及 next to、opposite 等地点表达。
demo-city.author: LinguaTree 虚构课程
demo-city.asr_text:
[Fictional teaching dialogue; no real location]
Visitor: Excuse me. Could you tell me how to get to the station?
Guide: Go straight, then turn left at the library. The station is opposite the park and next to the café.
Visitor: Thank you. Is it far from here?
Guide: No, it is a short walk.
Practice mistake: Turn to left at the library.
Correction: Turn left at the library.
demo-city.vlm_description: 虚构文字课程，没有关联的视频文件。
demo-city.manual_transcript:
[Fictional teaching dialogue; no real location]
Visitor: Excuse me. Could you tell me how to get to the station?
Guide: Go straight, then turn left at the library. The station is opposite the park and next to the café.
Visitor: Thank you. Is it far from here?
Guide: No, it is a short walk.
Practice mistake: Turn to left at the library.
Correction: Turn left at the library.

ores.description: 用 go straight、turn left 和 turn right 按顺序说明路线。

ores.ore_name: 地点介词 next to / opposite
ores.description: next to 表示紧挨着；opposite 表示在对面；between 表示在两者之间。
用 Could you + 动词原形提出礼貌请求，适用于问路、点餐和寻求帮助。

choice.question: “一直走，然后在图书馆左转。”最自然的英文是？
choice.explanation: turn left 是“向左转”；at the library 指转弯的地标。
options: Go straight, then turn left at the library.
Go straight, then turn to left at the library.
Go straight, then left turn the library.
Go straight, then turning left the library.

fill.question: 补全句子：The station is ___ to the café.（车站紧挨着咖啡馆。）
fill.explanation: next to 是固定搭配，表示紧挨着。

judge.question: “The station is opposite the park.” 表示车站紧挨着公园。
judge.explanation: opposite 表示在对面，next to 才表示紧挨着。

demo-hobbies.title: 聊聊尝试过的爱好（虚构演示）
demo-hobbies.summary: 虚构课程：用现在完成时谈经历，再用一般过去时补充具体时间。
demo-hobbies.author: LinguaTree 虚构课程
demo-hobbies.asr_text:
[Fictional teaching dialogue]
Speaker A: Have you ever tried painting?
Speaker B: Yes, I have. I joined a painting class last Saturday.
Speaker A: Have you tried pottery as well?
Speaker B: No, I have never tried it, but I would like to.
Practice mistake: I have joined a painting class last Saturday.
Correction: I joined a painting class last Saturday.

ores.description: have / has + 过去分词可以谈论到现在为止的经历，不强调已结束的具体过去时间。
描述昨天、上周等已结束时间中的动作时，使用一般过去时。
ever 常用于询问是否有过某种经历；never 表示从未。

choice.question: 哪一句正确询问对方是否有过画画的经历？
choice.explanation: 现在完成时疑问句用 Have + 主语 + 过去分词；try 的过去分词是 tried。

fill.question: 补全句子：I ___ a painting class last Saturday.（join）
fill.explanation: last Saturday 对应一般过去时，join 的过去式为 joined。

judge.question: “I have never tried pottery.” 表示到现在为止从未尝试过陶艺。
judge.explanation: have never + 过去分词描述截至现在没有过的经历。

corrections.original: I have joined a painting class last Saturday.
corrections.corrected: I joined a painting class last Saturday.
corrections.explanation: last Saturday 是已结束的明确过去时间，因此用 joined，而不是 have joined。

supplements.title: ever 和 never 放在哪里？
supplements.content: 谈经历时，ever / never 通常放在 have / has 与过去分词之间：Have you ever tried…? I have never tried…
supplements.relation: 同一虚构课程中的关联知识

structured_content.content: have / has + 过去分词可以谈论到现在为止的经历，不强调已结束的具体过去时间。
主语 + have/has + 过去分词；Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词…?

I have tried painting, but I have never tried pottery.
I joined a painting class last Saturday.
Have you ever tried pottery? I have never tried it.
last Saturday 是已结束的明确过去时间，因此用 joined，而不是 have joined。

demo-cafe.scenario_title: 在虚构的书店寻求帮助
demo-cafe.scenario_description: 你来到一家虚构书店，想找一本英语练习册，并请店员推荐适合初学者的书。
demo-cafe.user_task: 用 2–3 句英文说明你想找什么，并用 Could you 提出一个请求。
demo-cafe.reference_answer: I’d like an English workbook, please. Could you recommend a book for beginners?
demo-cafe.sample_answer: I’d like an English workbook, please. Could you recommend a book for beginners?

demo-city.scenario_title: 为虚构展览的访客指路
demo-city.scenario_description: 在一座虚构展馆中，问讯台旁边是咖啡区。访客需要一直走，在咖啡区右转，才能到画廊。
demo-city.user_task: 用 2–3 句英文说明去画廊的路线，至少使用一个地点介词。
demo-city.reference_answer: Go straight and turn right at the café. The café is next to the information desk. The gallery is on your left.
demo-city.sample_answer: Go straight and turn right at the café. The café is next to the information desk. The gallery is on your left.

demo-hobbies.scenario_title: 在虚构兴趣小组中自我介绍
demo-hobbies.scenario_description: 你参加一个虚构的周末兴趣小组。大家正在聊尝试过的活动以及想学的新技能。
demo-hobbies.user_task: 用 3 句英文说一种尝试过的活动、一个具体过去的经历，以及一种从未尝试过的活动。
evaluation_criteria: 区分经历与明确过去时间
使用 never 表达未有的经历
demo-hobbies.reference_answer: I have tried painting. I painted a landscape last Sunday. I have never tried pottery, but I would like to.
demo-hobbies.sample_answer: I have tried painting. I painted a landscape last Sunday. I have never tried pottery, but I would like to.
